text: The CT scan confirms a right upper lobe mass, which explains the weight loss and likely the anemia. To determine if the lower leg swelling is due to venous obstruction from the tumor or another cause, do you have any pain or warmth in your legs, and have you noticed any facial swelling or distended neck veins?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the smoking history and right upper lobe mass, I suspect Superior Vena Cava Syndrome causing your leg swelling and facial changes. Let's confirm the extent of the obstruction and rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: CT_Venogram REQUEST TEST: BNP

text: The normal BNP and venogram rule out heart failure and typical SVC obstruction, so the leg swelling is likely due to hypoalbuminemia from the malignancy.
